youtube.title: Ben Franklin & John Adams had to share a bed in 1776 🪟💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Benjamin Franklin and John Adams really had to share ONE bed... and fought over a window all night. 🪟🥶

The Founding Fathers were roommates and it was NOT giving teamwork.

Window open or closed? Pick a side 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on John Adams' own diary: in September 1776 he and Franklin shared a tiny inn room in New Jersey and argued about the window until Adams fell asleep during Franklin's lecture on colds.

#benjaminfranklin #johnadams #foundingfathers #historymemes #history #ushistory #shorts
